biography: Stephen Earle, a name now synonymous with both breathtaking overtakes and frustrating inconsistency in the GT racing world, hails from the dusty backroads of rural Texas. His journey began not on a racetrack, but behind the wheel of his grandfather's beat-up pickup truck, navigating treacherous dirt trails. This baptism by fire instilled in him a raw car control and a fearless attitude that would later define his racing style. He transitioned from local dirt track events to regional karting, showcasing a natural talent that caught the eye of Milano GT36's junior development program. His early seasons were marked by flashes of brilliance interspersed with costly errors, a pattern that continues to both thrill and frustrate fans. Currently, Earle finds himself at a critical juncture, battling to prove he can consistently deliver championship-caliber performances for Milano GT36 and solidify his place among the sport's elite. He is known for his aggressive passes and has earned the respect of many drivers.
drivingStyle: Earle's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward approach characterized by late braking, aggressive corner entries, and a willingness to push the limits of grip. He's known for his spectacular overtaking maneuvers, often diving down the inside of corners where others wouldn't dare. While this boldness can lead to stunning victories, it also makes him prone to mistakes, particularly under pressure. Tire management is sometimes an issue, as his aggressive style tends to wear down his rubber faster than his rivals. However, when he's 'in the zone,' Earle is a formidable force, capable of extracting every last tenth of a second from his machine.

careerHighlight: Winning the GT World Challenge America championship in 2021 after a season-long battle with his rivals. He secured the title with a dominant victory in the final race at Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 24 Hours of Spa in 2022. A costly mistake that cost his team a potential victory.
